{{Quote|The Empire is desperately trying to maintain its power on the planet in the face of growing opposition from the Alliance... which makes Kelada starport ripe territory for opportunistic smugglers.|[[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]]|<ref name="Smuggler's Log">{{JournalCite|1|Smuggler's Log}}</ref>}}
'''Kelada''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Anarid Cluster]]. It was controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] opposition grew stronger, an increasing number of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] frequented the planet, many of them hanging out at [[Lorana's Labyrinth]].

==Description==
Kelada was located within the [[Kelada system/Legends|Kelada system]], in the [[Duluur sector/Legends|Duluur sector]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] which connected it to [[Enisca]] and [[Foless/Legends|Foless]].<ref name="TEA" /> Kelada's surface was divided between industrial wasteland and natural areas, including several large forests and a vast savannah.<ref name="R&R" />

==History==
Kelada was within [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that remained loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" /> Later, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Kelada was an important asset for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] due to its production of [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] and [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], as well as components for [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] and [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. A giant assembly factory operated by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] was especially valued by the Empire.<ref name="R&R" /> Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Rebel Alliance operative [[Vewin]] was captured by Imperial agents on Kelada.<ref name="DED">{{WEGCite|story=Dead End Drop|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> In the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Imperial [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] transported components from dismantled factories on recently-abandoned worlds to Kelada, where they were used in the construction of several new factories. As a defense against [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] attack, the engineers also set up a [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150 Planet Defender]] near the planet's main [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]].<ref name="R&R" />

There was also an Imperial [[skunkworks]] on Kelada, although the top designers at the skunkworks disappeared from the radar, alongside hundreds of schematics for experimental weapons the months prior to the [[Thrawn campaign]]. The reasons behind the disappearance would not be revealed until a few months after the crisis, when the reborn [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had his fleet attack from [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
